name: Echoes From Below
description:
About This Game

Echoes Below is a tactical dungeon-crawler RPG about the bonds forged between hunters in the dark.

Lead The Descent

Recruit hunters from the village and lead them through the lantern-lit depths of the Below in tactical body-swap combat. Forge bonds as you fight: a stray spell sparks a feud, a last-second rescue sparks love. Make camp to rest, cook, and make some pep-talk. Return to the surface to recover your strength, spend the spoils, and grieve for the lost.

Features

  • Bond in the Below
    Hunters develop relationships as they fight together: rivalries, romances, mentorships, impacting party combat dynamics.

  • Tactical Body-Swap Combat
    Take direct control of party members in turn-based grid combat with destructible terrain, knockback, and mana-free cooldown skills.

  • Morale System
    The dungeon wears hunters down. Let morale hit zero and they may flee the depths, or turn on the party.

  • 27 Unique Characters
    Get to know a rich cast of characters and their classes: Knight, Barbarian, Scout, Mage, Miner, Priest, and Gourmet.

  • Permadeath
    The dead stay dead. Lovers grieve, students inherit grudges, and rivals rejoice.

  • Hand-crafted 2D Fantasy Art
    Moody, lantern-lit depths and detailed sprite-work.

How many will you bring home?
short_desc: Lead a guild of hunters in this tactical dungeon-crawler RPG where personal bonds of love, rivalry and grief shape your tactics, and permadeath makes every loss matter. How many will you bring home?
